sampling.population: XM blobs whose paths match /\bkg(?:_\d+)?\.xm$/i; keygen-labeled music only
sampling.selection: Deduplicate by Git blob SHA; sort SHA-256(seed + NUL + blob SHA) lexicographically; take first 256. No duration or benchmark identity enters selection.

measurement.meaning: Approximate first-subsong duration, not a rendered export length or unique-material measurement

policy.basis: Conservative rounded lower-tail sufficiency threshold: 11/256 sampled first passes below 30 s; fifth percentile 30.72 s. Not a historical minimum or a listener-validated quality scale.

limitations: Convenience archive, not a census or artist-independent random sample of the scene.
XM-only and filename-label filter omit other tracker formats and mislabeled or differently labeled music.
Distinct bytes can contain the same composition under different titles or edits.
First subsong only; three sampled modules expose additional subsongs.
libopenmpt duration estimates are not exact FT2 replay or audible-duration measurements.
Thirty audible seconds and linear scaling are benchmark policy choices, not estimated listener preferences.

secondary_source.convention: Curator says any looped track loops once and then has a 4-second fade-out. These export lengths are not used to estimate first-pass duration.
